name: theme.intact_camp_shakedown_fight_mcw
description: Full-scene thematic playtest: an intact McWilliams/Basecamp with several armed camp NPCs reaches a bandit shakedown, chooses Fight, then advances a short combat window so the tester can judge whether camp NPCs and bandits behave believably.

steps.label: post_load_intact_camp_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-load gameplay screen on the armed intact-camp footing before shakedown advancement; this is startup/load and scene-footing evidence only

steps.label: preflight_armed_camp_npc_snapshot
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved overmap NPC metadata is recorded before the fight so the readout can separate camp NPCs from bandits and later duplicates

steps.label: disable_safe_mode_before_shakedown_fight
steps.expected_visible_fact: safe mode is off and gameplay remains focused before shakedown turns advance

steps.label: advance_299_turns_to_shakedown_edge
steps.expected_immediate_state: bounded turn advance reaches the shakedown gate edge; proof is deferred to the same-run demand-surface artifact after the final turn

steps.label: advance_final_turn_to_shakedown
steps.expected_visible_fact: Bandit shakedown dialogue is visible inside the intact camp with player-facing Pay/Fight choices

steps.label: audit_intact_camp_shakedown_surface
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact did not prove the intact-camp bandit Pay/Fight shakedown surface
steps.expected_immediate_state: same-run debug log names camp_style/open_shakedown, reachable goods, demanded toll, visible Pay/Fight responses, and basecamp inventory reach

steps.label: choose_fight_inside_intact_camp
steps.expected_visible_fact: Fight was selected from the visible shakedown menu; the scene should return to live camp/combat contact rather than silently paying or closing without consequence

steps.label: audit_intact_camp_fight_branch
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact did not prove the selected Fight branch for the intact-camp shakedown
steps.expected_immediate_state: same-run debug log records the fight branch and preserves demanded/reachable values

steps.label: advance_120_turns_for_camp_fight_readout
steps.expected_visible_fact: a bounded combat window has advanced after the Fight branch; tester must judge whether armed camp NPCs and bandits moved, targeted, and escalated believably

playtest_rubric.primary_question: Did choosing Fight inside an intact armed camp produce a fun, intense, readable fight, or did camp NPCs/bandits behave like confused primitives?

evidence_contract.claim: an intact-camp bandit shakedown can be reached, the Fight branch can be selected, and a bounded live combat window can be captured for subjective full-scene review
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for thematic fight behavior
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No full-scene fight credit unless startup/load, armed-camp NPC snapshot, visible Pay/Fight demand, same-run fight artifact, and post-fight combat-window capture all exist.
